title: Kenyan Sardine Skewers with Fried Onions
description: A flavorful and spicy appetizer that combines the taste of Kenya with the simplicity of a sardine skewer, finished with crispy fried onions.
instructions: Alternate sardines, onions, bell pepper, and tomatoes on skewers.
Brush skewers with lime juice and sprinkle with Kenyan spice blend.
Grill skewers for 5-7 minutes, or until sardines are cooked through and vegetables are tender.
While skewers are cooking, heat vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add sliced onions to the pan and fry until crispy and golden brown.
Remove skewers from grill and brush with additional lime juice, if desired.
Serve with fried onions and enjoy!
